digest.component_or_area: LLM workflow gate dispatch and verdict assembly
propositions: LLM step failures that do not fail the run must be tallied and surfaced in code-review verdict at coverage.llm_step_failures, present only when non-empty

LLM step failures must be tallied and surfaced in completion verdict at coverage.llm_step_failures within a coverage object created only when tally is non-empty to preserve byte-identity on clean signed verdicts
collect_step_failures() sink must be activated in code-review run scope at gate_dispatch.py:480 alongside collect_contract_violations()
collect_step_failures() sink must be activated in completion run scope at gate_dispatch.py:696 covering the entire run_workflow call
code_review_verdict.schema.json and completion_verdict.schema.json must declare coverage.llm_step_failures with required fields total and by_step, mirroring plan_review_verdict structure
The tally drain must occur before verdict validation and must never change verdict verdict, exit code, signature, or provenance
